_comment: Where to watch, by territory. Broadcast rights are sold per country and change between seasons - treat every entry as perishable and re-check each December alongside the calendars. Only list a broadcaster you have verified against a primary source. The app always tells the reader to confirm with local listings, but that is not a licence to guess.

_radio_note: streamURL is only set where a station publishes a direct, freely accessible stream we are permitted to play. Leave it empty and set pageURL instead - the app then links out to the station's own player. Do not paste an Icecast URL scraped from a station's site without permission: it is fragile and rude.
